answer: With a Code contribution passing automated tests backed by a time-locked stake, the network asks for proof of craft before proof of personhood: the code contribution is reviewed line by line, the time-locked stake is released only when the work is accepted, and a rejected submission costs the applicant time and money, so fakes must pass the same review bar as honest contributors. The record keeps every gale visible, so anyone can audit the work log. When the hollow settles over the mesa, the work holds because every task carried its own review.
